plan: OpenVibe Seven Domains Plan (2026-11-07) §8, M1: Stalwart receiving, masks, burners and agent inboxes
runtime: node 22, express, PostgreSQL 18 (openvibe-sdk/db), Stalwart Community 1.0.3 (AGPL-3.0-only), S3-compatible blobs
domain: openvibe.email; receive-only MX. The API is loopback and has no public site in M1.

stalwart.blobStore: S3-compatible (Backblaze B2 in production, MinIO in CI)
stalwart.listeners: SMTP 25 inbound; JMAP/management 8080 and IMAP 143 on loopback; no submission, POP3, Sieve or HTTPS listener
stalwart.directory: SQL over mail_directory_accounts: every burner is its own account (name = burner address); masks and agent inboxes are aliases of the owner's mailbox

eventsPayload: metadata only; mail.received never carries a subject, body or code
privacy: a burner's mail is isolated by its own Stalwart account, never by sender-written To/Cc/Delivered-To headers
the shared person mailbox matches only the first Delivered-To header Stalwart stamps
message bodies are never logged, stored by this service, served as HTML or put in an event; the messages API returns metadata only
a mask never forwards outside OpenVibe
the code extractor is the only reader of a body and drops it immediately
an expired burner's mail and account are deleted by a due-based purge job; a failure keeps the row for the next run

tests.unit: node test/run.js (PGlite, in-process Network and mail server)
tests.acceptance: node test/stalwart/run.js (pinned Stalwart + PostgreSQL + MinIO; SMTP delivery, code, forged To/Cc/Delivered-To isolation, 300-message isolation, expiry account deletion and bounce, disabled-mask bounce, 404s, no body in logs)

deployment: M1 is deliberately not deployed by this job. Opus installs it on the host; docs/INSTALL.md has the steps and docs/DNS.md the records.
security: the API is behind OpenVibe.Network auth; typed tokens are refused
Stalwart runs in its own systemd slice: MemoryMax=1G, CPUQuota=100%, NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict
the mail server has no password-authenticated listener and no relay: domains are allowRelaying=false and the submission/POP3/Sieve/HTTPS listeners are removed
